pipelines.name: apriltag-cam1
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://mediaserver:8554/retail-cam1 latency=200 ! decodebin3 ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory) ! sscape_timestamp_capture name=timesync ntp-server=ntpserv ! gvadetect scheduling-policy=latency batch-size=2 inference-interval=1 model-instance-id=retail model=/home/pipeline-server/models/intel/person-detection-retail-0013/FP32/person-detection-retail-0013.xml model_proc=/home/pipeline-server/models/object_detection/person/person-detection-retail-0013.json device=GPU pre-process-backend=va-surface-sharing ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-tensor-data=true name=metaconvert ! vapostproc ! video/x-raw,format=BGRA ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=BGR ! sscape_post_inference_data_publish name=datapublisher ! appsink sync=true

metadatagenpolicy.description: One of detectionPolicy (default), detection3DPolicy, reidPolicy, classificationPolicy, ocrPolicy

publish_image.description: Publish annotated JPEG to scenescape/image/camera/<cameraid> each frame

detection_labels.description: Comma-separated allow-list of detection categories (e.g. "person,car"). Empty publishes all.
